pages.text: You can climb the tiers without fighting. The $(bold)Engineering$() lane lets you ascend by $(bold)building$(): refine ore, stamp metal, stand up machines, and bank the results as Codex tokens.$(br2)The in-game $(bold)Engineering$() questline follows the same steps; open it with $(bold)/icraft_quests open Engineering$().

pages.title: The Four Rungs
pages.text: $(li)$(t1)Tier 1$(): ore $(bold)doubling$() (Create).$(li)$(t2)Tier 2$(): ore $(bold)tripling$() and power (Thermal).$(li)$(t3)Tier 3$(): the $(bold)5x$() chain (Mekanism).$(li)$(t4)Tier 4$(): fusion, fission and $(bold)antimatter$().$(br2)Each rung mints tokens toward the next tier. See $(l:icraft:progression/tier_unlock_checklist)Targets & Boss Rush$(/l).

pages.title: How Tokens Work
pages.text: Carry refined metals and finished machine blocks to the Codex and $(bold)Submit$() them. Machine blocks mint big, bulk metals mint per stack up to a cap, and nothing is ever lost.$(br2)Check your standing any time with $(bold)/icraft codex balance$(). At $(t4)Tier 4$() surplus tokens convert to XP: see $(l:icraft:progression/token_exchange)The Token Exchange$(/l).
